actual_scope: Enclose the selected PR1094 conservative complex moment, including the inherited bad-residue surcharge, by a positive binomial series that does not import the retained logarithm or exponential engines, and recompute the recorded conservative kappa grid point.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one selected pricing claim and an independent exact enclosure. The native endpoint is already certified by Mercator, base-two, and the code-disjoint atanh sweep. This check is the conservative bracket of the same frozen profile, which that sweep does not evaluate with the surcharge enabled.
bottleneck_link: The complex primitive binds the selected kappa. The conservative endpoint is the same profile priced with the old surcharge, so its sign decides whether that extra charge still leaves a feasible saving. No new kappa is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop after the conservative bracket, the native-with-surcharge rejection, the conservative kappa identity, and the failure controls. Do not start a construction or the full cold replay.
evidence: PASS_SELECTED_CONSERVATIVE_BINOMIAL. Conservative endpoint 1675462673946628390003/10^24 has binomial moment strictly below one; the next 10^-24 grid point is strictly above one. Both residuals overlap the recorded Mercator and base-two intervals. Restoring the surcharge at the native endpoint puts the moment strictly above one. Conservative kappa equals 104541262139063/62500000000000000. Selected kappa is unchanged.
